# Fuaran — a UI-as-data language for AI-authored interfaces

> Fuaran is a typed UI tree with a canonical JSON wire format. An AI agent constructs and edits
> a user interface by emitting the tree (or small path-addressed edit ops) as JSON — no framework
> code, no CSS. The wire format is deterministic (byte-stable, hash-chainable) and designed so a
> model can emit valid UI in one turn and self-correct from structured errors. Apache-2.0.

If you are an AI agent asked to build or edit a Fuaran UI, read the authoring guide and the wire
format spec first — together they are the complete contract for emitting valid trees and edit ops.

## Start here (author + edit)

- [AI authoring guide](docs/AI_AUTHORING_GUIDE.md): how to emit a valid tree from a prompt — the
  node kinds, the flat `"kind"`-tagged JSON shape, bindings, actions, the 10 edit ops (TreeOp), the
  runtime-introspection tools, and a full closed-loop worked example. The single best entry point.
- [Wire format specification](docs/WIRE_FORMAT.md): the canonical, language-neutral JSON contract —
  the encoding rules, the `$type` discriminator map, structured payload positions, the `UpdateProp`
  path grammar, and the versioning/forward-compatibility rules. The authority; hosts conform to it.
- [Error codes + recovery](docs/ERROR_CODES.md): the structured decode/apply/binding error codes.
  Every failure names the problem and enumerates the valid alternatives, so you can self-correct
  without guessing.

## Reference

- [README](README.md): what ships (`Fuaran.UI.*` packages) and how the pieces fit.
- [Stability policy](STABILITY.md): which surfaces are stable and what a breaking change is.
- [Validator manifest](docs/VALIDATOR-MANIFEST.md): the FUARAN* validation codes.

## Conformance

- [Wire-format fixtures](../wire-format-fixtures): the executable conformance corpus (node / op
  round-trips, reject cases, chain records, floats, unicode). Concrete examples of valid and invalid
  wire JSON — pattern-match off these when in doubt.
